research_notes: Blocked for headline calculation: official full career sequence recovered, but journalism employer breakdown, working hours and consultancy full-time activity are not established.
Primary ministerial biography, contemporary news and member's parliamentary remarks supplement the official year labels. A member-site about-page fetch failed; no restriction bypassed.
Do not import third-party January 1 timestamps for these year-only APH entries. Neither marketing nor newspaper work is assumed to have occupied complete calendar years.

Follow-up2026-10-02: disaggregated official1986–1998 journalism span into three identified outlets, preserving broad dates here without duplicating them across employers. Added2024 surf-club governance and explicitly voluntary junior-sport work.

Targeted own-site, newspaper archive, employer/control-history and marketing-name searches did not establish individual journalism transitions or consultancy trading/legal name and substantive full-time hours. UK CDK/Amazing Marketing and NHS plastic surgeon namesakes were rejected. UQ historical newspaper-ownership PDF fetch failed;1958 indexed ownership does not establish whole1986–1998 tenure.

Next leads: historical mastheads/staff records at each named outlet; consultancy registration or contemporaneous client records; LEBTA annual reports for two presidential terms. No source restriction bypass or outreach. Headline years remain unknown, not zero.

Third follow-up3October2026: a2016 parliamentary speech now sequences newspaper work before regional television and places WIN Television work broadly '20-odd years ago', supporting a1990s point without inventing a year boundary. Targeted searches still did not resolve Gippsland Times-to-Express-to-WIN transitions, legal employing entities/control, consultancy trading name, hours or business-association terms. The broad phrase is retained only as evidence context; no headline totals changed.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: targeted outlet, WIN, consultancy and LEBTA searches returned the member's broad first-person sequence, known two-term association service and a2016 retrospective '20-odd years ago' WIN observation, but no individual newspaper/television transition, historical employing legal entity, marketing-business trading name, paid fraction or presidential term dates. A current about page says he ran his own marketing business, corroborating self-employment but adding no boundary or hours. Same-name medical and overseas results were rejected. Journalism control and hours, consultancy intensity and association dates remain unresolved; no headline change.

Secondary register extraction suggests chair as of15July2024 and surf role as of4August2024, but linked primary parliamentary PDF returned restricted URL and ordinaryHTTP403; those dates are not adopted as appointment boundaries. Own marketing trading name, hours and historical journalism employer transitions/control remain unresolved; targeted ownership searches returned material outside his tenure. Next primary register, old mastheads, marketing registration and association term records.

Fifth follow-up 5 October 2026: refreshed primary APH/Defence/member indexes and targeted historical newspaper ownership, WIN journalism and marketing-business searches. Contemporary by-election summaries reiterate Ryan chief-of-staff service, without original appointment/leave evidence. Current Latrobe Valley Express Partnership branding and current advertising contacts do not establish ownership or the legal employer during the 1986–1998 journalism envelope; Trove digitised Gippsland Times title ends in 1954 and cannot answer his later employment terms. No dated personal newspaper-to-television transition, marketing trading entity, full-time hours or association presidential boundaries recovered.
